replication.claim: Curve neurons are tuned to one orientation
replication.published: each curve detector responds to curves in a narrow orientation band (radial tuning curves)
replication.ours: median orientation selectivity 0.95 vs 0.10 for 20 random mixed3b neurons

replication.claim: Curve neurons prefer curves to straight lines
replication.published: near-zero activations are mostly straight lines; synthetic curves reach up to 24σ
replication.ours: 10/10 neurons respond > 1.5× more to their best curve than to any straight line

replication.published: the family covers the full circle (joint tuning curves)
